command: echo '=== INTEGRATION VERIFICATION RUN ===' && grep -cF '> Tagline: a scratch repository used for autonomous-dev end-to-end smoke tests.' README.md && awk 'NF{last=$0} END{print last}' README.md && tail -c 1 README.md | xxd && tail -c 2 README.md | xxd && head -n 3 README.md && grep -q $'\r' README.md; echo "CR_exit=$?" && LC_ALL=C grep -q '[^[:print:][:space:]]' README.md; echo "NONASCII_exit=$?" && grep -ic 'autonomous-dev' README.md && grep -ic 'smoke test' README.md && git log --oneline -1 && gh pr view 6 --repo pwatsonr/smoke-hello --json number,title,state,url
